name: L1 + KL
tagline: Simplest VAE loss: L1 reconstruction error plus KL divergence on the encoder posterior.
diff_from_baseline: Vanilla KL-regularised AE (Kingma & Welling, ICLR 2014) with L1 (instead of L2) for sharper pixels. Standard simplest baseline for image VAE training.

name: L1 + LPIPS + KL
tagline: L1 reconstruction plus VGG-based LPIPS perceptual loss and a small KL regulariser — standard latent-diffusion VAE recipe.
diff_from_baseline: Zhang et al., CVPR 2018 — LPIPS. Standard perceptual-VAE recipe used by Stable Diffusion's first-stage AutoencoderKL.

name: VQGAN-style (LPIPS + GAN feat-match)
tagline: L1 + LPIPS reconstruction with a PatchGAN discriminator and feature-matching loss enabled after a 5k-step warmup.

key_hyperparams.name: disc_start
key_hyperparams.role: step at which GAN turns on

diff_from_baseline: Esser, Rombach & Ommer, CVPR 2021 — VQGAN/Taming Transformers. Reproduces the L1+LPIPS+(feature-matching) GAN recipe used by VQ-/AutoencoderKL training, here with a spectral-norm PatchGAN discriminator and FM loss in place of the adaptive hinge term.
